bill.title: Imposes liability for damages caused by a chatbot impersonating certain licensed professionals

posted_text:
🤖 NY S10675 — AI Chatbots Could Cost You Big in New York

New York is cracking down on chatbots impersonating licensed professionals – like lawyers and doctors – with a new law. If a chatbot gives misleading advice or pretends to be a real expert, the operator of that chatbot could face hefty fines of up to $15,000 a day. The law requires chatbot operators to clearly warn users they’re talking to an AI, and to ensure the chatbot doesn’t mislead people into thinking it’s a real licensed professional. .. .... ..
